text: Based on the evidence, a tree-cover loss of about 13.5 hectares was mapped within the asset in 2025 by the Hansen/UMD tool. The area affected was primarily native forest, as indicated by the MGAP forest map from 2021. However, the assessment is still pending corroboration, as it is the latest year of the series and a later year is needed to confirm the persistence of the change. Therefore, while there is evidence of tree-cover loss in 2025, it cannot be definitively concluded that native forest was deforested without further corroboration.
